refused_staged_not_appended_note: the DRAFT field holds PROSE, not a list of ids: "S870's staged quote (absent on page; source re-opened as S893 with a fresh quote)". A counter that reads this field with an id-list parser (round-74's _id_list) raises ConfigError on it. The ids it names are recovered by scanning for S-ids: S870 (the staged row) and S893 (the lane row). S870 is NOT a refused row — it is in the frozen row_set as lane S893; what is refused is the staged QUOTE, so S893 is admitted only if this round's Gate locates a fresh quote.
url_field_note: the map's `url` is the string the landed row's source cell must carry verbatim. For S892 the claim's document cell writes the PDF filename with SPACES ('2014 marrone age dor---2.pdf') while the staged row and the L1's own lesson draft write it %20-ENCODED ('2014%20marrone%20age%20dor---2.pdf'); the map carries the %20 form and lists both in url_variants, so the landed row and the map agree whichever the builder writes — but the two must not diverge, because a counter checks the map url as a substring of the source cell.
substitution_rule: SIMULTANEOUS single pass over the staged ids with ONE lookup table. A sequential per-id replacement corrupts the result: the lane ids S885..S893 are themselves staged ids in the campaign namespace (staged S885 = Kotobank, staged S890 = Kaluzynska, staged S891 = Zhao et al.), and the four persee-1113 staged ids S876/S885/S917/S921 all collapse onto lane S885. Two of them (staged S885, staged S893) carry a number that is also a lane id. One pass over the table only; never a per-id sweep.
round_specific_hazards: The campaign's own ID-REMAP.md (lanes/kotodama/ID-REMAP.md) states: "The map is scoped per round: the same id in two rounds names two different rows, so a round-blind substitution would move one round's citations onto another's rows while every structural check stayed green." The prose ids S744 and S763 in the staged narrative files are exactly that hazard: they are scope-file ids of earlier campaign rounds, not staged registry rows, and in the LANE registry S744 is the ushanka page and S763 is the tafl-games article.

S744 appears in three of the five staged narrative files (amend-2026-10-23.md:11, amend-2026-10-23b.md:12, amend-2026-10-23c.md:12) and S763 in one (amend-2026-10-23c.md:12). Each is rewritten to the lane id of the SAME document, or removed.

The staged S885 (Barthes, Communications 8) and the lane id S885 are the same NUMBER but the assignment is not identity: staged S885's document is Barthes, and lane S885's document is Barthes too, so this one is a genuine same-number same-document coincidence; every other assignment in the map moves the number.
